The logic of 0 and 1

foundation of every computer, and so of every AI system.

slides.title: Testing an inference
slides.text:
Testing an inference
The inference from A₁, …, Aₙ to B is valid iff every valuation
making all premises true makes B true: [A₁] ∩ … ∩ [Aₙ] ⊆ [B].
